ops.body:
Coordinator update 2026-09-26T23:10Z:
- **synckit, cc-sync/artifact-delivery @ ff34ba5 (PR #4 CI green):**
  - Harness + WaitIdle rebased linearly as 1e9dcdb/ada0882.
  - Refutation of 803da5d found 7 defects; 5 are fixed failing-first:
    - rollback spares concurrently published objects;
    - stranded objects stay hidden until durable;
    - matching-stale apply finalizes acked pins;
    - restricted sender is checked before bulk decode;
    - capability retry before first delivery.
  - CommitBatch re-measured at 4.4–5.4s / 16384 objects, with identical fsync counts. The 1m42 was disk contention, not a regression.
  - Still open, in Run wf_619de18b-756: #5 (a cleanup failure skips the supersede check) and #4 (`synckitd reconcile` only kicks the scheduler, so new peers get no lane).
- **synckit rpc.ErrUnknownMethod:** cc-sync/rpc-unknown-method @ abfdf14 (from 803da5d; delivery, syncservice and consent clients wrap %w; WireBuild unchanged). Folds into the synckit final.
- **cc-sync status-degrade @ 7978d35:**
  - Status degrades on ErrUnavailable; ErrSynckitdTooOld is mapped from rpc.ErrUnknownMethod.
  - realproc passes on a go.work: TestRealProcessHost PASS and TestVersionSkewOldSynckitd PASS against the old 9014672 tree; G1/G2 SKIP.
  - Decision: the list/kick too-old assertion is dropped. status is the reporting surface, and list keeps degrading so local recovery works offline.
  - The stale realproc workflow (wf_69d4edac-275) had respawned and pushed a competing degrade (cf07514). I stopped it. We keep our shape and merge the realproc tip's pin-default build. Run wf_e936b98c-136 does that merge, reruns realproc and runs the targeted refutation.
- **cc-sync fetch-policy @ ed254ed:**
  - FetchAllowed is now rechecked before each verification.
  - In-flight verify/git cancellation covers cellular, disconnected, unknown and manual-metered; auto-resume works.
  - Pickup now admits the LFS fetch against a live monitor. The old code read network state once at CLI start.
  - Refutation round 0 failed; repair is running (Run wf_3d1be1ea-ac2).
  - Pickup's in-flight LFS cancellation needs reposync. Option C chosen, Run wf_ae2319e6-666 on cc-sync/rs-restore-cancel:
    - Restore rolls back what it created on failure/cancel, which also fixes the Ctrl-C leak that contradicted the contract;
    - temp-ref cleanup runs uncancelled;
    - a caller-scoped LFS fetch ctx maps a cancelled fetch to LFSPending.
- **reposync fix groups:**
  - The capture lane was lost to a harness SendMessage-resume mishap after 49c71c6 (L0-5/6/7).
  - Its continuation is Run wf_c0f7de5e-963: L0-1/2/4/11 plus L0-3(a) and L0-8(a), then a targeted refutation.
  - Restore and verify groups are still running in wf_37624322-e25. Once they finish, the coordinator runs the final merge itself, applying history-cache-v2.patch.
- **synckit docs:** moved onto the harness-bearing tip. Fact-check corrections applied; slop-cop clean on new prose (Run wf_3092c8a6-5c4).
- **Orca:** fix groups import-ownership (b8376a4), layout-remap (0bb467c) and picker-bridge (e41f622) are done. Merge → refutation → rendered QA still pending in wf_96a9397c-ea4.
